description: Trim gain, stereo width (mid/side), mono, channel swap, polarity and DC removal.
name: Utility

description: Six-band parametric equalizer: Butterworth high/low-pass (12-48 dB/oct), low and high shelf/peak bands and two fully parametric mid bands (RBJ biquads).
name: Parametric EQ

description: Resonant multimode state-variable filter with cutoff LFO; ideal for automated sweeps.
name: Filter

description: Feed-forward soft-knee compressor with stereo-linked detection, parallel mix and external sidechain input (for ducking, e.g. bass keyed by kick).
name: Compressor

params.description: Use the sidechain source track as the key signal
params.name: External Sidechain

params.description: Key on the kick of a full drum bus (e.g. 120 Hz)
params.name: Sidechain Low-Pass

presets.description: Duck against the kick of the sidechain source (low-passed key)
presets.name: Sidechain Pump

description: Lookahead brickwall limiter with optional 4x oversampled true-peak detection. Introduces latency equal to the lookahead (compensated automatically).
name: Limiter

description: Noise gate with hysteresis and hold, or downward expander.
name: Gate / Expander

description: Stereo feedback delay with tempo sync, ping-pong and band-limited repeats.
name: Delay

description: Algorithmic reverb via a synthesized, frequency-dependent decaying impulse response and partitioned FFT convolution.
name: Reverb

params.description: High-frequency decay relative to the RT60
params.name: Damping

description: Convolution with an impulse response loaded from the project's media (device state key 'ir_asset_id').
name: Convolution Reverb

params.description: mono_sum: L+R into a stereo IR
params.name: Input

description: Waveshaping saturation and distortion with IIR oversampling against aliasing.
name: Saturation

description: Polyphonic subtractive synthesizer: 2 band-limited oscillators with unison, noise, resonant state-variable filter with envelope, amp envelope, LFO, mono/legato glide.
name: Sonara Poly Synth

presets.description: Saw plus sub square, mono with slight glide
presets.name: Analog Bass

description: Synthesized drum machine on the General MIDI percussion map (36 kick, 38 snare, 39 clap, 42/44/46 hats, 41-50 toms, 49 crash, 51 ride, ...).
